title: Monomial quotients are Tor independent over a log regular chart
statement:
Let $S$ be a locally Noetherian log regular fs log scheme [def-trf-fs-log-blowup] and let $\bar s$ be a geometric point. Let $A=\mathcal O_{S,\bar s}$ be its strict local ring (the stalk of the etale structure sheaf [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]). Let $Q\to M_S$ be a chart inducing an isomorphism $Q\cong\overline M_{S,\bar s}$, with $Q$ sharp fs. Let $\Lambda$ be a localization of $\mathbf Z[1/N,\zeta_N]$, for an integer $N$ invertible in $A$ and a chosen primitive $N$th root of unity in $A$, giving $A$ a $\Lambda$-algebra structure. Let $P$ be an fs monoid and $\gamma:Q\to P$ a homomorphism with injective group completion and finite torsion subgroup of its cokernel of order invertible in $A$. Set $R=\Lambda[P]$, $C=\Lambda[Q]$, and $B=A\otimes_C R$. These monoid rings have basis $z^p$, with $z^pz^{p'}=z^{p+p'}$.

For every monoid ideal $J\subseteq P$ (a subset satisfying $J+P\subseteq J$, including the empty subset), let $(J)\subseteq R$ be generated by its monomials. Then, for every $i>0$,
$$\operatorname{Tor}^{C}_i(A,R/(J))=0,\qquad \operatorname{Tor}^{R}_i(B,R/(J))=0.$$
The Tor functors are [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules]. The same vanishings hold after adjoining finitely many polynomial variables to $R$ and $B$ and additionally killing any subset of those variables in the second argument: if $R'=R[y_1,\ldots,y_s]$, $B'=A\otimes_C R'$, and $K=(J,y_j:j\in L)$ for $L\subseteq\{1,\ldots,s\}$, then $\operatorname{Tor}^{C}_i(A,R'/K)=\operatorname{Tor}^{R'}_i(B',R'/K)=0$ for all $i>0$.

source.place: Expose X 1.3(vii), printed p.140, and proof of Lemma 1.5, printed pp.141--142: Kato (1994) 6.1 used for Lambda[P] and its monomial-ideal quotients, with the free symmetric factor. The change from the base chart ring to R uses the Tor-independent cartesian square in 1.3(vii).
